name: The St. Regis Downtown Dubai
positioning: St. Regis hotel on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, a few minutes from Dubai Mall, with Italian and Japanese restaurants, a hammam spa and round-the-clock butler service
best_for: Travelers who want a canal-side base near Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera
Guests who enjoy St. Regis rituals like afternoon tea and champagne sabering

facts.text: The hotel is set along the Dubai Water Canal on Marasi Drive, steps from Dubai Mall.
The hotel is five minutes from Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains and Dubai Opera.
The hotel is 15 minutes from Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai World Trade Center.
BASTA! blends a Roman trattoria, a Florentine steakhouse and a Neapolitan pizzeria, with Dubai Water Canal views.
TABU serves contemporary Japanese dishes on the mezzanine.
TABU offers an Omakase experience of a series of courses.
Every spa treatment comes with an additional 30-minute sensory experience in the en-suite steam room or sauna.
The spa offers 24 karat gold age-defying facials.
Rooms have a rain shower, a stand-alone bathtub and walk-in closets.
The Royal Suite has a living room and a dining area with a fully equipped kitchen, bar and dining table.
All rooms and suites have St. Regis butler service around the clock.
The hotel holds a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star Award.

highlights.text: The Marasi Mary is The St. Regis Bar's local take on the Bloody Mary, with tomato, Arabic savory spices and a hint of watermelon.
Champagne sabering takes place daily at The St. Regis Bar.
Ginori Terrace serves the St. Regis Afternoon Tea on Ginori 1735 porcelain, overlooking the Dubai Water Canal, with decor from Ginori's Domus collection.
The St. Regis Spa has six suites and offers Flotation Pod therapy and a traditional Arabian Hammam.
The infinity pool is on the third floor, with views of the Downtown Dubai skyline and the Dubai Water Canal.

considerations.text: Rooms look over the Dubai Water Canal, Downtown, or have partial views of Burj Khalifa.
WhataHotel notes the busy downtown location may lack a tranquil resort atmosphere.
